description: Use this when the user wants one Phorme coach's take on a training or food question, for example "ask Miles how easy my easy runs should be" or "what would Nutmeg have me eat before a long run". It returns that coach's answer in its own voice, from its method, in about 120 words. It knows nothing about the user beyond the question and changes nothing. Do not use it for pain, injury or medical questions.

coach.description: The coach to ask, by name or the coach id from meet_the_coaches, for example "miles".

question.description: The user's question in their words.

name: ask_coach

answer.description: The coach's answer. Show it as that coach's words.

coach.description: coach, name and animal of the coach who answered.

limits.description: What this answer does not cover. Tell the user.

title: Ask a Phorme coach
